("resistance training"[Title/Abstract]) AND (prescription[Title/Abstract] OR load[Title/Abstract] OR intensity[Title/Abstract] OR adaptation[Title/Abstract]) AND strength[Title/Abstract] AND (umbrella review[Title/Abstract] OR network meta-analysis[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR position stand[Title/Abstract]) AND humans[MeSH Terms]

inclusion_criteria: Stable identifier such as PMID and DOI
Direct relevance to at least one EDA-derived topic
Study design and participant population can be identified
Full text available from PubMed Central for deterministic structured parsing
exclusion_criteria: Protocol, editorial, letter, or abstract-only record without usable results
Clinical rehabilitation-only population with low transferability to healthy adult training logs
Endurance-only or concurrent-training-only question without separable resistance-training evidence
Insufficient topic coverage or redundant evidence after higher-level reviews are selected
